captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, arrow-shaped template with a uniform thickness. The main body consists of a rectangular shaft terminating in a pointed triangular arrow head. Two small, vertical cylindrical handles project upwards from the center of the rectangular shaft, spaced closely together to serve as a grip.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric template in OpenSCAD with options for different base shapes, including a rectangular strip, an arrow, and a heart. The template should have adjustable basic dimensions (Width, Height, and Thickness) and feature two small cylindrical handles positioned along its center axis for easy gripping.
captions.factory: The design uses conditional logic to select between three modules: landingStrip(), arrowStrip(), and heartStrip() based on a Template_Shape parameter. The arrowStrip() module is built by combining a central cube for the shaft with a rotated cube (rotated 45 degrees) that is sliced with a difference boolean operation to form the pointed arrowhead. Two cylinder primitives are translated and unioned on top of the base plate to act as the handles.
